verses.original: אֵ֜לֶּה מַסְעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצְא֛וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם בְּיַד־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh mas·‘ê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer yā·ṣə·’ū mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lə·ṣiḇ·’ō·ṯām bə·yaḏ- mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn
verses.literal: These are the journeys of the Israelites when they came out of the land of Egypt by their divisions under the leadership of Moses and Aaron
verses.literalPt: Estas são as jornadas dos filhos de Israel, pelas quais saíram da terra do Egito, segundo as suas turmas, sob a direção de Moisés e de Arão.

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ מוֹצָאֵיהֶ֛ם לְמַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְאֵ֥לֶּה מַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם לְמוֹצָאֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·tōḇ mō·šeh ’eṯ- mō·w·ṣā·’ê·hem lə·mas·‘ê·hem ‘al- pî Yah·weh wə·’êl·leh mas·‘ê·hem lə·mō·w·ṣā·’ê·hem
verses.literal: At the LORD’s command Moses recorded the stages of their journey These are the stages listed by their starting points
verses.literalPt: Moisés escreveu os lugares de que saíram nas suas jornadas, de acordo com a ordem de Jeová; estas são as suas jornadas segundo os lugares de que saíram.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֤וּ מֵֽרַעְמְסֵס֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן מִֽמָּחֳרַ֣ת הַפֶּ֗סַח יָצְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּיָ֣ד רָמָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·ra‘·mə·sês ba·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·ri·šō·wn mim·mā·ḥo·raṯ hap·pe·saḥ yā·ṣə·’ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·yāḏ rā·māh lə·‘ê·nê kāl- miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: On the fifteenth . . . day of the first month on the day after the Passover the Israelites set out from Rameses They . . . marched out defiantly . . . in full view of all the Egyptians
verses.literalPt: Partiram de Ramessés no primeiro mês, aos quinze dias do primeiro mês; no dia depois da Páscoa, saíram os filhos de Israel afoitamente à vista de todos os egípcios,

verses.original: וּמִצְרַ֣יִם מְקַבְּרִ֗ים אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בָּהֶ֖ם כָּל־ בְּכ֑וֹר וּבֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה שְׁפָטִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miṣ·ra·yim mə·qab·bə·rîm ’êṯ ’ă·šer hik·kāh Yah·weh bā·hem kāl- bə·ḵō·wr ū·ḇê·lō·hê·hem ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh šə·p̄ā·ṭîm
verses.literal: who were burying - all their firstborn whom the LORD had struck down among them for the LORD had executed judgment against their gods
verses.literalPt: enquanto estes sepultavam a todos os seus primogênitos, a quem Jeová havia ferido entre eles. Contra os seus deuses também executou Jeová juízos.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵרַעְמְסֵ֑ס וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּסֻכֹּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·ra‘·mə·sês way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·suk·kōṯ
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . set out from Rameses and camped at Succoth
verses.literalPt: Tendo os filhos de Israel partido de Ramessés, acamparam-se em Sucote.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִסֻּכֹּ֑ת וַיַּחֲנ֣וּ בְאֵתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּקְצֵ֥ה הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mis·suk·kōṯ way·ya·ḥă·nū ḇə·’ê·ṯām ’ă·šer biq·ṣêh ham·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: They set out from Succoth and camped at Etham on the edge of the wilderness
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Sucote, acamparam-se em Etã, que está na extremidade do deserto.

verses.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵֽאֵתָ֔ם וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ עַל־ פִּ֣י הַחִירֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י בַּ֣עַל צְפ֑וֹן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י מִגְדֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·’ê·ṯām way·yā·šāḇ ‘al- pî ha·ḥî·rōṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê ba·‘al ṣə·p̄ō·wn way·ya·ḥă·nū lip̄·nê miḡ·dōl
verses.literal: They set out from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth opposite . . . Baal-zephon and they camped near Migdol
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Etã, voltaram a Pi-Hairote, que está defronte de Baal-Zefom; e acamparam-se defronte de Migdol.

verses.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הַֽחִירֹ֔ת וַיַּֽעַבְר֥וּ בְתוֹךְ־ הַיָּ֖ם הַמִּדְבָּ֑רָה וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר אֵתָ֔ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mip·pə·nê ha·ḥî·rōṯ way·ya·‘aḇ·rū ḇə·ṯō·wḵ- hay·yām ham·miḏ·bā·rāh way·yê·lə·ḵū de·reḵ šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm bə·miḏ·bar ’ê·ṯām way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·mā·rāh
verses.literal: They set out from Pi-hahiroth and crossed through the sea into the wilderness and they journeyed three days . . . . . . . . . into the Wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Pi-Hairote, passaram pelo meio do mar ao deserto; e, depois de terem andado caminho de três dias no deserto de Etã, acamparam-se em Mara.

verses.original: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִמָּרָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אֵילִ֑מָה וּ֠בְאֵילִם שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֞ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֛יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים תְּמָרִ֖ים וַיַּחֲנוּ־ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mim·mā·rāh way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’ê·li·māh ū·ḇə·’ê·lim šə·têm ‘eś·rêh ‘ê·nōṯ ma·yim wə·šiḇ·‘îm tə·mā·rîm way·ya·ḥă·nū- šām
verses.literal: They set out from Marah and came to Elim . . . where there were twelve . . . springs . . . and seventy palm trees and they camped there
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Mara, vieram a Elim. Em Elim havia doze fontes de água e setenta palmeiras; e ali se acamparam.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאֵילִ֑ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ עַל־ יַם־ סֽוּף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·’ê·lim way·ya·ḥă·nū ‘al- yam- sūp̄
verses.literal: They set out from Elim and camped by the Red Sea
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Elim, acamparam-se junto ao mar Vermelho.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִיַּם־ ס֑וּף וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּר־ סִֽין׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mî·yam- sūp̄ way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·miḏ·bar- sîn
verses.literal: They set out from the Red Sea and camped in the Desert of Sin
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido do mar Vermelho, acamparam-se no deserto de Sim.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּדְבַּר־ סִ֑ין וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּדָפְקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mim·miḏ·bar- sîn way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·ḏā·p̄ə·qāh
verses.literal: They set out from the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido do deserto de Sim, acamparam-se em Dofca.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִדָּפְקָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּאָלֽוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mid·dā·p̄ə·qāh way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·’ā·lūš
verses.literal: They set out from Dophkah and camped at Alush
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Dofca, acamparam-se em Alus.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאָל֑וּשׁ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בִּרְפִידִ֔ם וְלֹא־ הָ֨יָה שָׁ֥ם מַ֛יִם לָעָ֖ם לִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·’ā·lūš way·ya·ḥă·nū bir·p̄î·ḏim wə·lō- hā·yāh šām ma·yim lā·‘ām liš·tō·wṯ
verses.literal: They set out from Alush and camped at Rephidim where there was no water for the people to drink
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Alus, acamparam-se em Refidim, onde não havia água para o povo beber.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרְפִידִ֑ם וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·rə·p̄î·ḏim way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·miḏ·bar sî·nāy
verses.literal: They set out from Rephidim and camped in the Wilderness of Sinai
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Refidim, acamparam-se no deserto de Sinai.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּקִבְרֹ֥ת הַֽתַּאֲוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mim·miḏ·bar sî·nāy way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·qiḇ·rōṯ hat·ta·’ă·wāh
verses.literal: They set out from the Wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido do deserto do Sinai, acamparam-se em Quibrote-Hataavá.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקִּבְרֹ֣ת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּחֲצֵרֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū miq·qiḇ·rōṯ hat·ta·’ă·wāh way·ya·ḥă·nū ba·ḥă·ṣê·rōṯ
verses.literal: They set out from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Quibrote-Hataavá, acamparam-se em Hazerote.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֲצֵרֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִתְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·ḥă·ṣê·rōṯ way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·riṯ·māh
verses.literal: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Hazerote, acamparam-se em Ritmá.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִתְמָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִמֹּ֥ן פָּֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·riṯ·māh way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·rim·mōn pā·reṣ
verses.literal: They set out from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Ritmá, acamparam-se em Rimom-Perez.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִמֹּ֣ן פָּ֑רֶץ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּלִבְנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·rim·mōn pā·reṣ way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·liḇ·nāh
verses.literal: They set out from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Rimom-Perez, acamparam-se em Libna.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִלִּבְנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּרִסָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mil·liḇ·nāh way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·ris·sāh
verses.literal: They set out from Libnah and camped at Rissah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Libna, acamparam-se em Rissa.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵרִסָּ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בִּקְהֵלָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·ris·sāh way·ya·ḥă·nū biq·hê·lā·ṯāh
verses.literal: They set out from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Rissa, acamparam-se em Queelata.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקְּהֵלָ֑תָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּהַר־ שָֽׁפֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū miq·qə·hê·lā·ṯāh way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·har- šā·p̄er
verses.literal: They set out from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido do monte Queelata, acamparam-se no monte Séfer.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽהַר־ שָׁ֑פֶר וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּחֲרָדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·har- šā·p̄er way·ya·ḥă·nū ba·ḥă·rā·ḏāh
verses.literal: They set out from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido do monte Séfer, acamparam-se em Harada.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֲרָדָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמַקְהֵלֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·ḥă·rā·ḏāh way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·maq·hê·lōṯ
verses.literal: They set out from Haradah and camped at Makheloth
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Harada, acamparam-se em Maquelote.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמַּקְהֵלֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּתָֽחַת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mim·maq·hê·lōṯ way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·ṯā·ḥaṯ
verses.literal: They set out from Makheloth and camped at Tahath
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Maquelote, acamparam-se em Taate.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִתָּ֑חַת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּתָֽרַח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mit·tā·ḥaṯ way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·ṯā·raḥ
verses.literal: They set out from Tahath and camped at Terah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Taate, acamparam-se em Tara.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִתָּ֑רַח וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמִתְקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mit·tā·raḥ way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·miṯ·qāh
verses.literal: They set out from Terah and camped at Mithkah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Tara, acamparam-se em Mitca.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמִּתְקָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּחַשְׁמֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mim·miṯ·qāh way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·ḥaš·mō·nāh
verses.literal: They set out from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Mitca, acamparam-se em Hasmona.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽחַשְׁמֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּמֹסֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·ḥaš·mō·nāh way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·mō·sê·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: They set out from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Hasmona, acamparam-se em Moserote.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִמֹּסֵר֑וֹת וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בִּבְנֵ֥י יַעֲקָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mim·mō·sê·rō·wṯ way·ya·ḥă·nū biḇ·nê ya·‘ă·qān
verses.literal: They set out from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Moserote, acamparam-se em Bene-Jaacã.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִבְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקָ֑ן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּחֹ֥ר הַגִּדְגָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mib·bə·nê ya·‘ă·qān way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·ḥōr hag·giḏ·gāḏ
verses.literal: They set out from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Bene-Jaacã, acamparam-se em Hor-Gidgade.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵחֹ֣ר הַגִּדְגָּ֑ד וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּיָטְבָֽתָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·ḥōr hag·giḏ·gāḏ way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·yā·ṭə·ḇā·ṯāh
verses.literal: They set out from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Hor-Gidgade, acamparam-se em Jotbatá.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִיָּטְבָ֑תָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעַבְרֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mî·yā·ṭə·ḇā·ṯāh way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·‘aḇ·rō·nāh
verses.literal: They set out from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Jotbatá, acamparam-se em Abrona.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽעַבְרֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעֶצְי֥וֹן גָּֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·‘aḇ·rō·nāh way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·‘eṣ·yō·wn gā·ḇer
verses.literal: They set out from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Abrona, acamparam-se em Eziom-Geber.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעֶצְי֣וֹן גָּ֑בֶר וַיַּחֲנ֥וּ בְמִדְבַּר־ צִ֖ן הִ֥וא קָדֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·‘eṣ·yō·wn gā·ḇer way·ya·ḥă·nū ḇə·miḏ·bar- ṣin hî qā·ḏêš
verses.literal: They set out from Ezion-geber and camped at Kadesh in the Wilderness of Zin
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Eziom-Geber, acamparam-se no deserto de Zim (este é Cades).

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקָּדֵ֑שׁ וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר בִּקְצֵ֖ה אֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū miq·qā·ḏêš way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·hōr hā·hār biq·ṣêh ’e·reṣ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: They set out from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor on the outskirts of the land of Edom
verses.literalPt: E, tendo partido de Cades, acamparam-se no monte Hor, na extremidade da terra de Edom.

verses.original: וַיַּעַל֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶל־ הֹ֥ר הָהָ֛ר עַל־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁ֑ם בִּשְׁנַ֣ת הָֽאַרְבָּעִ֗ים לְצֵ֤את בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֖י בְּאֶחָ֥ד לַחֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên ’el- hōr hā·hār ‘al- pî Yah·weh way·yā·māṯ šām biš·naṯ hā·’ar·bā·‘îm lə·ṣêṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ba·ḥō·ḏeš ha·ḥă·mî·šî bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš
verses.literal: At the LORD’s command Aaron the priest . . . climbed Mount Hor and died there on the first . . . day of the fifth month in the fortieth year after the Israelites . . . had come out of the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Arão, o sacerdote, subiu, por ordem de Jeová, o monte Hor e ali morreu no quadragésimo ano depois que os filhos de Israel saíram da terra do Egito, no quinto mês, no primeiro dia do mês.

verses.original: וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן בֶּן־ שָׁלֹ֧שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים וּמְאַ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה בְּמֹת֖וֹ בְּהֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·hă·rōn ben- šā·lōš wə·‘eś·rîm ū·mə·’aṯ šā·nāh bə·mō·ṯōw bə·hōr hā·hār
verses.literal: Aaron was 123 . . . . . . years old . . . when he died on Mount Hor
verses.literalPt: Arão tinha cento e vinte e três anos de idade, quando morreu no monte Hor.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֗ע הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲרָ֔ד וְהֽוּא־ יֹשֵׁ֥ב בַּנֶּ֖גֶב בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן בְּבֹ֖א בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî me·leḵ ‘ă·rāḏ wə·hū- yō·šêḇ ban·ne·ḡeḇ bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an bə·ḇō bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now the Canaanite king of Arad . . . who lived in the Negev in the land of Canaan heard that the Israelites . . . were coming
verses.literalPt: Então, ouviu o cananeu, rei de Arade, que habitava no Neguebe, na terra de Canaã, que vinham os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵהֹ֣ר הָהָ֑ר וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּצַלְמֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·hōr hā·hār way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·ṣal·mō·nāh
verses.literal: And the Israelites set out from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido do monte Hor, acamparam-se em Zalmona.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִצַּלְמֹנָ֑ה וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּפוּנֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū miṣ·ṣal·mō·nāh way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·p̄ū·nōn
verses.literal: They set out from Zalmonah and camped at Punon
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Zalmona, acamparam-se em Punom.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִפּוּנֹ֑ן וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּאֹבֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mip·pū·nōn way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·’ō·ḇōṯ
verses.literal: They set out from Punon and camped at Oboth
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Punom, acamparam-se em Obote.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵאֹבֹ֑ת וַֽיַּחֲנ֛וּ בְּעִיֵּ֥י הָעֲבָרִ֖ים בִּגְב֥וּל מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·’ō·ḇōṯ way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·‘î·yê hā·‘ă·ḇā·rîm biḡ·ḇūl mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: They set out from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim on the border of Moab
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Obote, acamparam-se em Ijé-Abarim, no território de Moabe.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעִיִּ֑ים וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּדִיבֹ֥ן גָּֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·‘î·yîm way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·ḏî·ḇōn gāḏ
verses.literal: They set out from Iyim and camped at Dibon-gad . . .
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Ijé-Abarim, acamparam-se em Dibom-Gade.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִדִּיבֹ֣ן גָּ֑ד וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּעַלְמֹ֥ן דִּבְלָתָֽיְמָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mid·dî·ḇōn gāḏ way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·‘al·mōn diḇ·lā·ṯā·yə·māh
verses.literal: They set out from Dibon-gad . . . and camped at Almon-diblathaim
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Dibom-Gade, acamparam-se em Almom-Diblataim.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵעַלְמֹ֣ן דִּבְלָתָ֑יְמָה וַֽיַּחֲנ֛וּ בְּהָרֵ֥י הָעֲבָרִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י נְבֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·‘al·mōn diḇ·lā·ṯā·yə·māh way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·hā·rê hā·‘ă·ḇā·rîm lip̄·nê nə·ḇōw
verses.literal: They set out from Almon-diblathaim and camped in the mountains of Abarim facing Nebo
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Almom-Diblataim, acamparam-se nos montes de Abarim, defronte de Nebo.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מֵהָרֵ֣י הָעֲבָרִ֑ים וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·hā·rê hā·‘ă·ḇā·rîm way·ya·ḥă·nū bə·‘ar·ḇōṯ mō·w·’āḇ ‘al yar·dên yə·rê·ḥōw
verses.literal: They set out from the mountains of Abarim and camped on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido dos montes de Abarim, acamparam-se nas planícies de Moabe, junto ao Jordão, na altura de Jericó.

verses.original: וַיַּחֲנ֤וּ עַל־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִבֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁמֹ֔ת עַ֖ד אָבֵ֣ל הַשִּׁטִּ֑ים בְּעַֽרְבֹ֖ת מוֹאָֽב׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·ḥă·nū ‘al- hay·yar·dên mib·bêṯ hay·ši·mōṯ ‘aḏ ’ā·ḇêl haš·šiṭ·ṭîm bə·‘ar·ḇōṯ mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: And there on the plains of Moab they camped by the Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth to Abel-shittim
verses.literalPt: E acamparam-se junto ao Jordão, desde Bete-Jesimote até Abel-Sitim, nas planícies de Moabe.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל־ יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh bə·‘ar·ḇōṯ mō·w·’āḇ ‘al- yar·dên yə·rê·ḥōw lê·mōr
verses.literal: On the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho . . . the LORD said to Moses
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés nas planícies de Moabe, junto ao Jordão, na altura de Jericó:

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kî ’at·tem ‘ō·ḇə·rîm ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên ’el- ’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: Speak to the Israelites . . . and tell them When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel e dize-lhes: Quando tiverdes passado o Jordão para a terra de Canaã,

verses.original: וְה֨וֹרַשְׁתֶּ֜ם אֶת־ כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם וְאִ֨בַּדְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־ מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ צַלְמֵ֤י מַסֵּֽכֹתָם֙ תְּאַבֵּ֔דוּ וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ בָּמֹתָ֖ם תַּשְׁמִֽידוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·raš·tem ’eṯ- kāl- yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ mip·pə·nê·ḵem wə·’ib·baḏ·tem ’êṯ kāl- maś·kî·yō·ṯām wə·’êṯ kāl- ṣal·mê mas·sê·ḵō·ṯām tə·’ab·bê·ḏū wə·’êṯ kāl- bā·mō·ṯām taš·mî·ḏū
verses.literal: you must drive out before you all the inhabitants of the land destroy all their carved images - and cast idols and demolish all their high places
verses.literalPt: desapossareis de diante de vós todos os habitantes da terra, destruireis todas as suas pedras em que há figuras e também todas as suas imagens fundidas e deitareis abaixo todos os seus altos.

verses.original: וְהוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וִֽישַׁבְתֶּם־ בָּ֑הּ כִּ֥י לָכֶ֛ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·raš·tem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wî·šaḇ·tem- bāh kî lā·ḵem nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ lā·re·šeṯ ’ō·ṯāh
verses.literal: You are to take possession of the land and settle in it for I have given you the land to possess
verses.literalPt: Tomareis a terra em possessão e habitareis nela, porque vos dei a vós esta terra para a possuirdes.

verses.original: וְהִתְנַחַלְתֶּם֩ אֶת־ הָאָ֨רֶץ בְּגוֹרָ֜ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם לָרַ֞ב תַּרְבּ֤וּ אֶת־ נַחֲלָתוֹ֙ וְלַמְעַט֙ תַּמְעִ֣יט אֶת־ נַחֲלָת֔וֹ אֶל֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יֵ֨צֵא ל֥וֹ שָׁ֛מָּה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל ל֣וֹ יִהְיֶ֑ה לְמַטּ֥וֹת אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תִּתְנֶחָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiṯ·na·ḥal·tem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ bə·ḡō·w·rāl lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯê·ḵem lā·raḇ tar·bū ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw wə·lam·‘aṭ tam·‘îṭ ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw ’el ’ă·šer- yê·ṣê lōw šām·māh hag·gō·w·rāl lōw yih·yeh lə·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem tiṯ·ne·ḥā·lū
verses.literal: And you are to divide the land by lot according to your clans Give a larger inheritance to a larger clan and a smaller inheritance . . . to a smaller one Whatever falls to each one by lot . . . will be his You will receive an inheritance according to the tribes of your fathers
verses.literalPt: Herdareis a terra por sortes, segundo as vossas famílias; à família que for grande, farás a sua herança proporcionalmente grande; e, à que for pequena, farás a sua herança proporcionalmente pequena. Seja qual for o lugar em que lhe cair a sorte, esse lhe pertencerá; herdareis segundo as tribos de vossos pais.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֨א תוֹרִ֜ישׁוּ אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָרֶץ֮ מִפְּנֵיכֶם֒ וְהָיָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תּוֹתִ֣ירוּ מֵהֶ֔ם לְשִׂכִּים֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וְלִצְנִינִ֖ם בְּצִדֵּיכֶ֑ם וְצָרֲר֣וּ אֶתְכֶ֔ם עַל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יֹשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō ṯō·w·rî·šū ’eṯ- yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ mip·pə·nê·ḵem wə·hā·yāh ’ă·šer tō·w·ṯî·rū mê·hem lə·śik·kîm bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem wə·liṣ·nî·nim bə·ṣid·dê·ḵem wə·ṣā·ră·rū ’eṯ·ḵem ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tem yō·šə·ḇîm bāh
verses.literal: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land before you those you allow to remain . . . will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides they will harass you in the land where you settle
verses.literalPt: Porém, se não desapossardes de diante de vós os habitantes da terra, os que deixardes ficar deles vos serão como cravos nos olhos e como espinhos nas ilhargas e vos perturbarão na terra em que habitardes.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּמִּ֛יתִי לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָהֶ֖ם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ka·’ă·šer dim·mî·ṯî la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lā·hem ’e·‘ĕ·śeh lā·ḵem
verses.literal: And then I will do to you what I had planned to do to them
verses.literalPt: Como pensei em fazer-lhes a eles, assim vos farei a vós.
